title: Tracecat 1.5.0
body_markdown:
## Breaking changes


- infra!: Move WAF ownership out of the Fargate stack ([#4145](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4145) )


## Security


- security(infra): Support workload IAM boundaries on Fargate ([#4142](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4142) )
- security(infra): Drop the RLS bypass where the tenant is already known ([#4135](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4135) )
- feat(infra): Set up database roles in the migrations container ([#4113](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4113) )
- feat(infra): Add a role upgrade command for existing installs ([#4111](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4111) )
- feat(infra): Add a Postgres role bootstrap and enforce-mode login check ([#4107](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4107) )
- feat(infra): Log in to Redis with cloud IAM tokens ([#4103](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4103) )
- security(actions+integrations): Opt-in SSH/Ansible errors, SSRF/ReDoS ([#4092](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4092) )


## Case management


- feat(cases+actions): Let workspace admins delete any case comment ([#4172](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4172) )
- feat(cases): Close sub-cases when parent case closes ([#4166](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4166) )
- fix(cases): Tidy case filters, search copy, and sub-cases panel ([#4165](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4165) )
- feat(cases+actions): Add sub-case actions for case deduplication ([#4160](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4160) )
- fix(cases): Create a case and its tags in one transaction ([#4155](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4155) )
- perf(cases): Start case-triggered runs in parallel ([#4104](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4104) )
- fix(tables+cases): Force row level security on dynamic tables ([#4089](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4089) )
- fix(cases): Match tag event triggers on the event's tag ([#4088](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4088) )
- fix(cases): Reject invalid timestamp case field values ([#4079](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4079) )
- test(cases): Cover deleting an already-removed case field ([#4077](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4077) )
- feat(cases): Deliver case triggers through a Postgres outbox ([#4068](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4068) )
- fix(cases): Number case panel hotkeys in tab order ([#3985](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3985) )


## Tables


- feat(mcp+tables): Add table folder tools to the MCP server ([#4188](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4188) )
- fix(tables): Import CSV into the current folder ([#4158](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4158) )
- fix(tables): Render quoted JSON and text column defaults ([#4078](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4078) )
- feat(tables): Sort the tables list by name, created or updated ([#4064](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4064) )
- feat(tables): Add folders to organize workspace tables ([#4019](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4019) )


## Agents


- feat(agents+ui): Pick Slack channels from a list when routing them ([#4187](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4187) )
- feat(agents): Add Tracecat to Slack in one click from a platform app ([#4183](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4183) )
- feat(agents+ui): Turn on Slack token rotation for new apps ([#4182](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4182) )
- fix(agents): Keep the MCP server up while agent workers drain ([#4181](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4181) )
- fix(agents): Treat managed provider outages as user-owned ([#4177](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4177) )
- fix(agents): Attribute direct-route LLM read timeouts to the user ([#4173](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4173) )
- feat(agents+ui): Show channel bots behind the preview entitlement ([#4171](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4171) )
- feat(agents): Add transport and app token to the Slack bot API ([#4162](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4162) )
- fix(engine+agents): Scope tier and channel-sink reads to their tenant ([#4141](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4141) )
- fix(agents): Classify raw provider transport errors as outages ([#4138](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4138) )
- fix(agents): Set RLS context on public agent channel requests ([#4133](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4133) )
- fix(agents): Return the same workflow agent output on every backend ([#4127](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4127) )
- feat(agents): Add the channel bot and thread tables ([#4120](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4120) )
- feat(agents): Accept channel messages idempotently by request id ([#4119](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4119) )
- feat(agents+ui): Add the channel bot admin API ([#4118](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4118) )
- feat(agents): Add a unique key on agent session id and workspace id ([#4117](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4117) )
- feat(agents): Record approval decisions per click before applying them ([#4116](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4116) )
- feat(agents): Deliver channel notices from the durable agent workflow ([#4115](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4115) )
- fix(agents): Stop LiteLLM cooldowns masking provider auth errors ([#4096](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4096) )
- fix(agents): Classify wrapped mid-stream rate limits as user errors ([#4094](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4094) )
- feat(agents): Run workflow agent actions on the selected backend ([#4081](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4081) )
- fix(agents): Classify Bedrock AssumeRole denials as user errors ([#4080](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4080) )
- fix(agents): Classify missing provider credentials as a user error ([#4073](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4073) )
- feat(agents+api): Add session result types and API extension socket ([#4067](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4067) )
- feat(agents+ui): Agent session feed ([#4065](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4065) )
- fix(agents): Classify managed LLM provider and gateway outages ([#4026](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4026) )
- fix(agents): Allow more than 50 tools on agent chat sessions ([#4012](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4012) )
- feat(agents): Add model lifecycle and opt-in retired model migration ([#3949](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3949) )
- feat(agents): Validate first-class LLM provider keys before save ([#3922](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3922) )


## Tracecat MCP


- fix(mcp): Request offline_access when clients omit scope ([#4071](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4071) )
- fix(mcp): Fix workflow and action descriptions in MCP authoring ([#4000](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4000) )


## Core actions


- fix(actions): Fit DuckDB to sandbox task and memory limits ([#4191](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4191) )


## Integrations


- revert(integrations+ui): Delete old registry when its URL changes ([#4168](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4168) )
- fix(integrations+ui): Delete old custom registry when its URL changes ([#4164](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4164) )
- feat(integrations): Add Socket MCP server to the catalog ([#4156](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4156) )
- feat(integrations): Support Atlassian OAuth in Confluence actions ([#4154](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4154) )
- feat(integrations): Add Atlassian OAuth to Jira and add JSM actions ([#4153](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4153) )
- feat(integrations): Add Zendesk OAuth client credentials provider ([#4152](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4152) )
- feat(integrations): Add Slack pin and bookmark actions ([#4150](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4150) )
- feat(integrations): Add Devin MCP server to the catalog ([#4144](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4144) )
- feat(integrations): Add CrowdStrike batch RTR and quarantine actions ([#4130](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4130) )
- fix(integrations): Fail MCP test cleanly if server is deleted mid-probe ([#4122](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4122) )
- feat(integrations): Add Swif actions and MCP server ([#4106](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4106) )
- feat(integrations): Add Trend Vision One search, response, TI actions ([#4098](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4098) )
- fix(integrations): Send PKCE for custom OAuth providers ([#4062](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4062) )


## Engine


- fix(engine): Flush partial NSTUN writes so large uploads don't stall ([#4146](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4146) )
- fix(engine): Raise the executor shutdown drain to 10 minutes ([#4099](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4099) )
- fix(engine): Retry actions interrupted by worker shutdown ([#4095](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4095) )


## API


- fix(api): Return 4xx for missing secrets, workflows and Bitbucket hosts ([#4163](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4163) )
- fix(rbac+ui): Drop secret read for registry sync and show repo ID ([#4137](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4137) )
- feat(api): Read OIDC client credentials from AWS Secrets Manager ([#4136](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4136) )
- feat(api): Sync workflow Python scripts as separate files ([#4125](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4125) )
- feat(api): Store Git sync case tags in one file ([#4124](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4124) )
- fix(api): Return 401 for webhook secrets with non-ASCII characters ([#4109](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4109) )
- fix(api): Return 422 for deeply nested invalid request bodies ([#4108](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4108) )

- fix(api): Skip locked API key last_used_at writes ([#4076](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4076) )
- fix(api): Return 400 for security-key sign-in without keys ([#4075](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4075) )

## User interface


- feat(ui+docs): Show OAuth and GitHub App setup URLs ([#4184](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4184) )
